title: Security/app vector consumers surface 7 implementation gaps + provably-wrong vectors
description:
Filed by python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py (drives announce_signed_data/sos_signature/sos_rate_limiting/group_oscore_key/confessions_rate/receipt_cbor.json through real lichen code). Divergences found, asserted as live behavior with xfail(strict)/skip pins per repo policy:

IMPLEMENTATION GAPS (impl more permissive/absent than spec):
1. P1 security: POST /sos performs NO signature verification (spec/12-apps.md 18.4.1 requires valid link-layer signature + silent drop). verify_sos_origin() has zero production callers; unsigned SOS POSTs return 2.01 Created. xfail(strict): test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped.
2. SOS burst allowance (spec table 'Burst allowance: 2') unimplemented: SosResource.check_rate_limit applies the 600s cooldown to every repeat, so a second SOS at +1s is rejected where spec permits. xfail(strict): test_burst_second_accepted_exact_pin.
3. SOS 4.29 responses carry no Retry-After payload (confessions 4.29 embeds {retry_after} CBOR). xfail(strict): test_third_before_cooldown_retry_after_pin (pins retry_after_s=300).
4. Rate-limiting time source defaults to wall-clock time.time in SosResource and ConfessionsResource (spec requires monotonic uptime); time_func is injectable but production wiring passes none. Documented green tests assert reality.
5. No monotonic origin-sequence validator for SOS origin signatures anywhere in python/src/lichen; SosRelay dedups exact (node,seq) only, so stale-but-unseen origin sequences are relayed (vector origin_sequence_rollback expects reject). Green live-behavior test documents it.
6. Group OSCORE key distribution (spec 18.8.5 / vector group_oscore_key.json) entirely absent from python/src/lichen: no pairwise wrap, key_epoch counter, 1-hour grace window, epoch rollback/future rejection, or membership rekey. 9/10 vectors UNDRIVABLE -> pytest.skip with reason; only id_context composition drivable via MemorySecurityContext.

PROVABLY-WRONG VECTORS (generator bugs, not impl bugs):
7a. sos_signature.json canonical_cbor_key_order pins [lat,lon,ts,node,type] and canonical_cbor_medical pins [msg,ts,...]; RFC 8949 s4.2.1 length-first order is ts-first ([ts,lat,lon,...] / [ts,msg,...]); cancel vector is correct. xfail(strict) x2.
7b. hourly_window_slides pins sos_in_window=0 at now=3600.001s (history 0/1000/2000ms) and post_after_hour_window_slides pins posts_in_window=0 at now=3601s (history 0/300/600s): strict '>' pruning correctly retains entries younger than 3600s, so real count is 2 in both. xfail(strict) x2.
7c. confessions_rate.json pins retry_after_s=15 and =20 exactly; ConfessionsResource returns int(remaining)+1 (=16/=21), a deliberate anti-truncation ceiling. xfail(strict) x2.

All other pins (announce transcript/signature/frame byte-exact x4, SOS transcript/domain/wire-format/replay, receipt CBOR byte-exact x5 + all rejects, all rate accept/reject boundaries incl. ==600s and ==30s inclusivity) pass byte-exact against the live implementation.
